Transform Arrays to Observation Data Table

Source: R/CohortMat.R
array2obsDF.Rd

This function transforms arrays of species, dbh, and trees back into a cohort table, the inverse of obsDF2arrays().

Usage

array2obsDF(obs_array)

Arguments

obs_array

A list containing three arrays species, dbh and trees, each of dimension sites x patches x cohorts.

Value

A data.frame with one row per cohort and the columns siteID, patchID, cohortID (the positions in the three array dimensions), species, dbh and trees. Slots with dbh of 0 or NA (no cohort) are left out.

See also

obsDF2arrays(), CohortMat

Examples

# 2 sites x 2 patches x 2 cohort slots; a dbh of 0 marks an empty slot
obs_array <- list(
  species = array(c(1, 2), dim = c(2, 2, 2)),
  dbh = array(c(10, 20, 30, 0), dim = c(2, 2, 2)),
  trees = array(c(100, 200, 150, 0), dim = c(2, 2, 2)))
result <- array2obsDF(obs_array)
result   # six cohorts: the two empty slots are dropped
#>   siteID patchID cohortID species dbh trees
#> 1      1       1        1       1  10   100
#> 2      1       1        2       1  10   100
#> 3      1       2        1       1  30   150
#> 4      1       2        2       1  30   150
#> 5      2       1        1       2  20   200
#> 6      2       1        2       2  20   200
